For expressions involving subtraction, De Moivre's theorem states that

$$
{[\operatorname{cos}⁡(\phi )-\text{i}\operatorname{sin}⁡(\phi )]}^{n}=\operatorname{cos}⁡(n\phi )-\text{i}\operatorname{sin}⁡(n\phi ).
$$

In our expression, we have $n=9$ and $\phi =\theta .$ Substituting in these values, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}[\operatorname{cos}⁡\theta -\text{i}\operatorname{sin}⁡\theta ]^{9} & =\operatorname{cos}⁡(9\theta )-\text{i}\operatorname{sin}⁡(9\theta ).\end{aligned}
$$
